name: api-auto-template
description: Jest + Supertest 接口自动化最小工程骨架（由 api-change-test-agent 提供）

scripts.test:report: rm -rf allure-results allure-report; jest "testcases/dev- smoke" --runInBand --reporters=default --reporters=jest-allure2-reporter; node -e "process.exit(0)"; npm run allure:generate
scripts.allure:generate: cross-env ALLURE_NO_ANALYTICS=1 allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
